input.summary: Extend the Section 4(c) licence to Company's affiliates on written notice and make it transferable to an M&A successor without Contractor's approval.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our fallback licence position requires affiliate coverage on written notice and transferability to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so we have added both to the Section 4(c) grant and confirmed the successor transfer needs no Contractor approval given the consent requirement in Section 10.

ops.oldText: (c) To the extent that Contractor incorporates any of Contractor's Information into the Works, Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
ops.newText: (c) To the extent that Contractor incorporates any of Contractor's Information into the Works, Contractor hereby grants to Company and its affiliates (on written notice to Contractor) a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense), transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition without Contractor's approval, to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
